ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The frog at the bottom of a well performs impossible actions: Baima Ai makes it swallow the moon, while Xueguan Zhiyin makes it fly into the sky. Later masters raise and verse the image as a deliberately cramped scene whose action exceeds its setting.
